```{r check_design_oats, include = FALSE, eval = FALSE}
results_all |> 
  filter(eq_scen_id == 8) |>
  group_by(building) |>
  distinct(design_oat) |>
  mutate(ashrae_99_6 = 4.7, ashrae_99 = 5.8) # for SAN FRANCISCO INTL, CA, USA (WMO: 724940)

results_all |> 
  filter(eq_scen_id == 8) |>
  group_by(building) |>
  summarise(min_oat = min(oa_t))
```

```{r oat_reset_hrs, include = FALSE, eval = FALSE}
results_all |>
  filter(eq_scen_id == 3) |>
  # group_by(building) |>
  mutate(oat_override = (!(operate_hp_tes) & hp_tes != 0)) |>
  summarize(hrs_oat_override = sum(oat_override), hrs_total = n(), .by = building) |>
  mutate(hrs_oat_override_percent = 100*hrs_oat_override/hrs_total)
```

```{r over_max, include = FALSE, eval = FALSE}
over_max = results_all |>
  group_by(building, eq_scen_id, tes_sizing, tes_control_id, desc) |>
  mutate(over = awhp_hhw - awhp_cap_h_total > 1e-3, ok = !over) |>
  summarize(tot_over = sum(over), tot_ok = sum(ok)) |>
  filter(tot_over > 0) |>
  mutate(plot = 20)

print(over_max, n = Inf)
```

```{r dominant_load, include = FALSE, eval = FALSE}
df |>
  group_by(building) |>
  summarize(total_hhw = sum(hhw), total_chw = sum(chw), peak_hhw = max(hhw), peak_chw = max(chw)) |>
  mutate(ratio_sums = total_hhw/total_chw, ratio_peaks = peak_hhw/peak_chw, ratio_peaks_chw = peak_chw/peak_hhw)
```

```{r reduction_2x_180, include = FALSE, eval = FALSE}
r_180_par = results_all |> filter(building == "180", eq_scen_id == 12) |> select(datetime, og_em = elec_h_emissions)
r_180_2xpar = results_all |> filter(building == "180", eq_scen_id == 13) |> 
  select(datetime, elec_h_emissions) |> 
  left_join(r_180_par, by = c("datetime")) |>
  mutate(diff = elec_h_emissions - og_em) |>
  filter(diff > 1)
```

```{r analysis, include = FALSE, eval = FALSE}
id = c("180", "205")
scen = c(4, 5)
bldg_results = results_all |> 
  # filter(building %in% id) |>
  filter(eq_scen_id %in% scen)
# bldg_results |>
#   pivot_longer(
#     cols = c(elec_awhp_h, TES_charge),
#     names_to = "meter",
#     values_to = "value"
#   ) |>
#   ggplot(aes(datetime, value, color=meter)) +
#   geom_line() +
#   facet_grid(eq_scen_id ~ building)

max_hhw = bldg_results |>
  group_by(building, desc) |>
  summarize(max_hhw = max(hhw), TES_size = max(TES_charge))
test = bldg_results |>
  left_join(max_hhw, by = c("building", "desc")) |>
  mutate(hhw_percent_tes = hhw/TES_size) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = hhw_percent_tes)) +
    geom_histogram(fill='orange', binwidth = 0.05) +
    labs(title = "HHW load percentage of TES (load/TES)") +
    facet_grid(building ~ desc)
```

```{r testing, include = FALSE, eval = FALSE}
# sum(filtered_results$gas_emissions)

write_csv_localtime = function(df, path, tz = "US/Pacific") {
    df_out = df |> mutate(datetime = format(with_tz(datetime, tz), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"))
    write_csv(df_out, path)
}
write_csv_localtime(results_all, "results_all.csv")
```

```{r partial2full, include = FALSE, eval = FALSE}
partials = summary |>
  filter(eq_scen_id == 4) |>
  select(building, partial_size = TES_size)

fulls = summary |>
  filter(eq_scen_id == 5) |>
  select(building, tes_sizing, TES_size) |>
  left_join(partials, by = c("building")) |>
  mutate(full_diff = 100*(TES_size- partial_size)/partial_size)
fulls
```

```{r short_cycling, include = FALSE, eval = FALSE}
max_cap = max(awhp_h_curve$cap_h)
max_cap * 3.412 / 12000 # in tons
min_cap = max_cap / 2 # assuming 2 compressors

print(
  results_all |>
    filter(eq_scen_id  %in% c(2, 3, 8, 13)) |>
    mutate(awhp_below_turndown = awhp_hhw < min_cap) |>
    group_by(building, desc) |>
    summarise(hrs_below_turndown = sum(awhp_below_turndown), total_hrs = n()) |>
    mutate(hrs_below_turndown_percent = hrs_below_turndown/total_hrs),
  n = Inf
)
```
